--- initial-production-contract
+++ paired-prior-production-contract
@@ -18,7 +18,7 @@
 
 Phase A (`layout`) executes the whole reviewed generic OPC package and two documentary role layout route. It returns complete structural layout or one closed NO_GO reason, retaining exposure. It does not initiate a sequence of new predicate experiments. A ready layout is only `LAYOUT_READY_MAPPING_UNBOUND`; numerical/scientific status remains `BLOCKED_SCHEMA`.
 
-Phase B requires a canonical binding at the fixed documentary binding slot plus an exact pinned phase-A public receipt and producer. Phase C requires its fixed binding plus exact phase-A and phase-B receipts. Every pinned file is bounded, canonical, and SHA-verified before target access. Roots for these fixed paths are unchanged custody no-follow routines. The inner prior-result validator retains the pure exact keys/types, history/cleanup, source, success and payload-recomputation checks, with the three explicit production marker substitutions. The frame carries the complete documentary binding for recomputation on the same buffer.
+Phase B requires a canonical binding at the fixed documentary binding slot plus both exact pinned phase-A public receipts and producers in ordered fixed slots 1 and 2. Phase C requires its fixed binding plus both phase-A and both phase-B receipts. Each prior pair must contain complete byte-identical canonical public projections before advancing; missing, duplicate, reordered, or divergent pairs block. Every pinned file is bounded, canonical, and SHA-verified before target access. Roots for these fixed paths are unchanged custody no-follow routines. The inner prior-result validator retains the pure exact keys/types, history/cleanup, source, success and payload-recomputation checks, with the three explicit production marker substitutions. The frame carries the complete documentary binding for recomputation on the same buffer.
 
 Root must freeze phase bindings only after independently verifying the prior operation's returned cleanup state, persisted receipt identity, source/producer identity, and permitted documentary evidence. A public file left behind by a later directory-close failure is not alone a completed operation. Approved definition texts may not come from an undeclared preview. If bindings cannot be justified, the route stops with unbound NO_GO; it does not infer coordinate meanings, invent exact text, or extract numerical values. Future binding pins are separately reviewed committed configuration, not caller flags.
 
@@ -26,7 +26,7 @@
 
 ## Report and exposure contract
 
-The outer report schema is `lupine.discovery.li_v3.readiness.production.v1`, profile `li_v3.complete_bounded_readiness.v1`. It contains implementation identity, observed fixed-source identity, prerequisite/capture identities, phase-binding pins, operation exposure, and `result`. The result is otherwise the pure report shape, with only schema `lupine.discovery.li_v3.readiness.result.v1`, `synthetic_fixture=false`, and `production_binding=FIXED_LI_V3_SOURCE_G34_PREREQUISITE`. Successful generated equivalence comparisons normalize exactly those three markers. Pure source code is byte-identical; `orchestration-copy.diff` shows the explicit production orchestration/prior-validator adaptation.
+The outer report schema is `lupine.discovery.li_v3.readiness.production.v1`, profile `li_v3.complete_bounded_readiness.v1`. It contains implementation identity, observed fixed-source identity, prerequisite/capture identities, phase-binding pins, operation exposure, and `result`. Returned phase-binding pins are detached copies, so modifying a report cannot mutate trusted configuration. The result is otherwise the pure report shape, with only schema `lupine.discovery.li_v3.readiness.result.v1`, `synthetic_fixture=false`, and `production_binding=FIXED_LI_V3_SOURCE_G34_PREREQUISITE`. Successful generated equivalence comparisons normalize exactly those three markers. Pure source code is byte-identical; `orchestration-copy.diff` shows the explicit production orchestration/prior-validator adaptation.
 
 Inner `header_replay_started/completed` describes the earlier payload-free header replay. Completion means its routine returned; `replay_matched` additionally records exact fixed projection equality. On a replay exception, completion is false and partial header processing/cleanup cannot be assumed complete. Inner archive flags describe the separately owned package archive. Member/decompression/UTF-8/XML counters describe subsequent metadata and selected-sheet processing. Whole-buffer identity and in-memory XML character exposure remain explicit; this is not target-free processing.
